scope: Four direct-only primitives at the seven already-supported exact Uniswap V4 PositionManager targets; 28 additions. No protocol/chain/target additions, old capability/ABI/scope/hash migration or multicall child expansion.

lifecycleEvidence.observation: Current official Mainnet Deployments list all seven exact PositionManagers and constructor-bound PoolManagers below. They are current listed V4 deployments, not superseded V3 or retired PM deployments. This deployment listing is not a live bytecode/execution guarantee.

executionSemantics.nativeValue: Zero for every primitive, including source-payable initializePool; no stranded-value allowance.
executionSemantics.initialization: Direct inherited PoolInitializer_v4.initializePool calls its immutable PoolManager.initialize. Only zero-hook PoolKeys; supplied nonnative currencies and known PoolManager are pause targets initially and finally. PoolManager failures are caught and return type(int24).max; authorization/transaction success does not imply successful initialization. Price, fee, tick spacing, ordering, pool existence and financial suitability remain caller/on-chain concerns.
executionSemantics.transfers: Recipient must exactly equal executionOwner; no sender/router sentinel substitution or third-party payout. from remains explicit and may differ from executionOwner, enabling incoming NFTs previously approved to this execution wallet. Source checks from ownership and caller authorization, clears token approval and requires PoolManager locked.
executionSemantics.callbacks: PositionManager.transferFrom invokes _unsubscribe for an existing stored subscriber, deletes its registration and makes a gas-limited best-effort notifyUnsubscribe call. It can fail for insufficient gas. Stored subscriber addresses are not recoverable from tokenId calldata. Safe overloads also invoke onERC721Received on executionOwner when it has code; four-argument safe transfer requires empty bytes but is NOT callback-free. No callback-free or exhaustive target attestation.
executionSemantics.directOnly: Primitive scopes are top-level only. Existing modifyLiquidities action scope/ABI/hash unchanged. Existing multicall allowedChildren remains ONLY its exact modifyLiquidities child; primitives are not added to the UR or PM nested language.
executionSemantics.authority: No approval, permit, subscriber-management, nonce, admin, unlock/callback or arbitrary executor functions admitted. all/custom grants, canonical ABI, independent pauses and atomic final authorization remain mandatory.

additions.label: Uniswap V4 initialize-pool
additions.description: Direct hookless pool initialization with zero native value; source may catch initialization failure.
warnings: Direct-only closed primitive; zero native value even when source ABI is payable. Catalog/source evidence is not a live runtime identity, funding, execution or financial-safety guarantee.
Exact custom capability grant or current all mode, canonical ABI and independent initial/final capability/chain/contract pauses remain mandatory.
Six deployments retain Sourcify match qualification, not exact_match. Monad remains explorer_verified with unknown proxy resolution; no crosschain source-grade promotion.

Hookless PoolKey only. Known immutable PoolManager and supplied nonnative currencies are pause-checked. Source catches initialization failure and returns int24.max; successful authorization or transaction does not prove pool initialized. Caller chooses price/fee/tick spacing and bears market/financial risk.

additions.label: Uniswap V4 safe-transfer-from
additions.description: Direct position NFT transfer to executionOwner only, including incoming previously approved positions; stored-subscriber and safe-recipient callbacks remain possible.
warnings: Direct-only closed primitive; zero native value even when source ABI is payable. Catalog/source evidence is not a live runtime identity, funding, execution or financial-safety guarantee.
Exact custom capability grant or current all mode, canonical ABI and independent initial/final capability/chain/contract pauses remain mandatory.
Six deployments retain Sourcify match qualification, not exact_match. Monad remains explorer_verified with unknown proxy resolution; no crosschain source-grade promotion.

Recipient must executionOwner. Incoming NFTs require prior on-chain owner approval to the execution wallet; this capability grants no approval or third-party payout authority. Source owner/caller/PoolManager-lock checks and token approval clearing remain authoritative.

Transfer can unsubscribe an existing stored subscriber and make a gas-limited best-effort callback, with insufficient-gas failure risk. Subscriber addresses and stored pool currencies cannot be enumerated from tokenId calldata; known-target pauses are not exhaustive callback attestation.
Safe transfer can invoke onERC721Received on executionOwner when it has code; empty callback bytes do not make this callback-free or guarantee recipient compatibility.
